items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Accessible, tokenized button with variants, sizes, icon and non-jittery loading states.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Bare text input plus a labeled Field with hint, error and automatic ARIA wiring.

items.name: field-input
items.title: Field + Input
items.description: Bare text input plus a labeled Field with hint, persistent description, error and automatic ARIA wiring.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal dialog built on Base UI with focus management, dismissal, scroll lock and portal rendering.

items.name: icon-button
items.title: Icon Button
items.description: Square icon-only button with required accessible name, tokenized variants/sizes, stable loading state and focus ring.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Multiline text input plus a labeled field with hint, error, optional auto-resize and a conditional character counter.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Checkbox with checked, unchecked and indeterminate states, label click and native form submission, built on Base UI.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: On/off switch for a single boolean setting with an accessible name, keyboard support and a moving thumb, built on Base UI.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hint on hover or focus of a single trigger, with collision-aware placement and Escape dismissal, built on Base UI.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Trigger-anchored popup with focus management, Escape and outside-press dismissal, collision-aware placement and scrollable long content, built on Base UI.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Index-based tab set with roving keyboard focus, an honest selected state, orientation (and axis-swap) control, Escape-to-clear and scrollable overflow, built on Base UI.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: Data-driven dropdown menu with keyboard/ARIA navigation, separators, disabled and destructive items and nested submenus, built on Base UI.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Determinate and indeterminate progress bar with a truthful percentage, accessible value announcements and an inert disabled state.

items.name: surface-card
items.title: Surface / Card
items.description: Tokenized base surface with solid/outline/ghost variants, optional header/body/footer regions and an opt-in interactive whole-surface button mode; no nested-card sprawl.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Accessible single-selection select with a tokenized trigger, keyboard and ARIA navigation, disabled options and optional client-side search, built on Base UI.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Severity-aware notification stack with deduplication, auto-dismiss, optional actions, dismiss-on-click and a polite/assertive live region, built on Base UI.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: Tokenized horizontal or vertical rule, presentational by default with an opt-in semantic separator role, built on Base UI.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Decorative loading placeholder with text, rectangle and circle silhouettes, reduced-motion safe and hidden from assistive technology.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Compact status pill for labels and metadata whose variants never rely on colour alone to convey meaning.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline notice for persistent messages with shape-distinct severity icons, an optional action and opt-in polite/assertive live-region roles.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Information-dense disclosure list with roving keyboard focus, measured-height panels and reduced-motion-safe animation, built on Base UI.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: Single-choice radio group with a required visible label per item, native input semantics and an invalid/error state, built on Base UI.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single-value or range slider with a real value contract, a formatted readout and full keyboard support, built on Base UI.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Navigation trail landmark that marks the current page with aria-current and can collapse long trails to their ends.

items.name: listbox
items.title: Listbox
items.description: Standalone single- or multiple-select listbox with aria-activedescendant navigation, grouping, type-ahead and full keyboard support.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table foundation with a scrollable container, an optional sticky header and controlled sortable columns.

items.name: form-summary
items.title: Form Summary
items.description: Accessible summary of validation failures that links back to each field, with opt-in polite/assertive live-region roles.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Collapsible application navigation rail whose parts share the collapsed state and keep every link's accessible name.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Filterable single- or multiple-select combobox with chips, an honest loading state and full keyboard support, built on Base UI.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: Keyboard-first modal command launcher that filters and runs commands, built on Base UI Dialog with motion enter/exit.

items.name: searchable-results
items.title: Searchable Results
items.description: Controlled search field with a results list, query highlighting and honest loading, empty and load-more states.

items.name: split-pane
items.title: Split Pane
items.description: Two-panel layout with a pointer- and keyboard-operable divider whose panel sizes stay clamped to valid bounds.

items.name: search-and-results
items.title: Search and Results
items.description: Search field, filter layer and honest results region composed from Searchable Results, Select, Checkbox, Badge and Alert, with dismissible filter chips and a `/` focus shortcut.

items.name: settings-section
items.title: Settings Section
items.description: Data-driven settings form with text, textarea, select, switch and checkbox fields, inline validation, dirty tracking and honest save, pending and error states.

items.name: process-monitor
items.title: Process Monitor
items.description: Multi-stage task monitor pairing an ordered stage list, a truthful progress bar and a scrollable log with terminal cancel, retry and dismiss actions.

items.name: resource-explorer
items.title: Resource Explorer
items.description: Hierarchical tree browser with roving focus, type-ahead, inline rename and keyboard reorder actions as an accessible alternative to drag and drop.

items.name: data-details-workspace
items.title: Data Details Workspace
items.description: Sortable list-and-detail workspace that places the Table in a Split Pane and keeps the selected row visible while the divider moves or the layout stacks.

items.name: guided-form
items.title: Guided Form
items.description: Multi-step form shell with per-step validation, an error summary that links back to fields, draft save and restore and a truthfully loading submit.

items.name: media-document
items.title: Media Document
items.description: Renderer-neutral composition document: typed artboard, layers, fonts and assets, deterministic serialization and validation, locale-aware text layout, and dependency-free SVG/PNG export with explicit fidelity diagnostics.

items.name: artboard
items.title: Artboard
items.description: Fixed-size design surface with explicit dimensions, background, safe region, bleed and crop, publishing a shared design-space context for authoring-time zoom, pan and selection.

items.name: editable-text
items.title: Editable Text
items.description: Composable text layer with styled spans, measured glyph runs, a deterministic wrap/shrink/clip/fit policy, locale and bidirectional support, pinned font fallback and text-as-text output.

items.name: media-frame
items.title: Media Frame
items.description: Places a referenced image, video or vector inside a layer box with explicit fit, focal point, mask and crop, without ever mutating the source asset's intrinsic dimensions.

items.name: layer-stack
items.title: Layer Stack
items.description: Ordered layer composition with stable ids, grouping, visibility, locking, opacity, blending and rectangular clipping, plus an accessible layer tree for selection, visibility and reordering.

items.name: alignment-guides
items.title: Alignment Guides
items.description: Non-exporting authoring overlay for grid, guides, safe region, centre axes, live measurements and snap feedback, sharing the pure snapping model with the document.

items.name: export-preview
items.title: Export Preview
items.description: Preview, inspect and export a composition at its output size, with bleed and crop, small-format inspection, missing-font and missing-asset warnings and downloadable SVG and PNG deliverables that match the preview byte for byte.

items.name: infographic-system
items.title: Infographic System
items.description: Dependency-free engine that turns a validated semantic InfographicSource into a renderer-neutral primitive layout: source schema, validation and content digests, deterministic text measurement and content requirements, editorial and bento grids, information blocks, structure visualizers, one shared chart grammar, the template catalog, the layout engine and static SVG/PNG export.

items.name: infographic-view
items.title: Infographic View
items.description: Deterministic DOM preview that draws a resolved infographic layout as accessible SVG, owning no layout, measurement or art direction so it cannot drift from the static exporter.

items.name: motion-track
items.title: Motion Track
items.description: Dependency-free motion kernel that evaluates a validated timeline of typed, keyframed tracks, sequences, staggers and constraints into renderer-neutral samples at an explicit frame, plus schema validation, tolerant parsing and stable JSON serialization.

items.name: motion-path
items.title: Motion Path
items.description: Renderer-neutral motion paths that flatten anchors into an arc-length-parameterised polyline and expose point, tangent and angle sampling, bounds, SVG `d` serialization and deterministic trim windows.

items.name: mask-reveal
items.title: Mask Reveal
items.description: Deterministic clip, alpha and luma matte resolver that sweeps a declaration rect along a chosen axis at a given progress, with feathering, stable compositing order and a declared capability fallback per matte kind.

items.name: shape-morph
items.title: Shape Morph
items.description: Contour shape morphing that validates compatibility, resamples rings deterministically and interpolates between two shapes, with explicit dissolve and cut fallbacks when contours cannot morph.

items.name: shared-element
items.title: Shared Element
items.description: Durable cross-cut element handoff that interpolates transform and opacity across a declared handoff range under cross-fade, cut or hold-old collision policies, with validation and contact queries.

items.name: motion-preset
items.title: Motion Preset
items.description: Constructive motion preset catalog that expands a declarative preset instance into concrete timeline nodes for fade, rise, pop, slide, kinetic and exit intents, with versioning, declared parameters and materialization diagnostics.

items.name: animated-text
items.title: Animated Text
items.description: Deterministic kinetic-text builder that segments a string into grapheme, word or line tokens and staggers a materialized preset across them, returning an evaluable timeline plus glyph ids and diagnostics.

items.name: scene-storyboard
items.title: Scene Storyboard
items.description: Serializable shot planner that orders shots across the composition timeline, validates continuity, handoffs, cues and coverage without throwing, and exposes clips, cues and timeline nodes for placement.

items.name: exploded-view
items.title: Exploded View 3D
items.description: Reversible hierarchical part separation with parent/local/world offsets, custom part/environment factories and camera-projected occlusion-aware annotations.

items.name: diagram-stage
items.title: Diagram Stage
items.description: Frame-addressable graph layouts with stable node/port identity, attached cubic connectors, arc-length data packets and customizable SVG rendering slots.

items.name: storyboard-shots
items.title: Storyboard Shots
items.description: Shared active-shot explanation and keyboard-operable shot navigation for a frame-addressed storyboard.

items.name: progressive-reveal
items.title: Progressive Reveal
items.description: Cue-addressable staged entrances and emphasis holds compiled to existing MG1 presets, with shared DOM and SVG composition slots.

items.name: camera-pose-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Pose
items.description: General quaternion and perspective/orthographic poses baked into existing MG1 channels; no engine import.

items.name: cinematic-camera-director
items.title: Cinematic Camera Director
items.description: Declarative semantic shots, world targets, bounded composition constraints and continuous quaternion handoffs compiled to MG1; optional Three.js preview.

items.name: camera-rig-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Rig
items.description: Renderer-independent orbit, dolly, crane, tracking, lens and roll choreography compiled to existing MG1 tracks.

items.name: camera-viewport-3d
items.title: 3D Camera Viewport
items.description: Optional Three.js perspective viewport with absolute-frame camera evaluation, scene lifecycle, fixed overlays and WebGL recovery.

items.name: camera-stage
items.title: Camera Stage
items.description: Frame-addressable SVG camera with pan, zoom, roll, cuts, subject fitting and screen-space overlays, compiled to existing MG1 tracks.

items.name: visual-transformation
items.title: Visual Transformation
items.description: Semantic 2D scene transformations compiled to MG1 tracks, explicit strategy fallbacks, immutable interruption history, seven reusable recipes and a frame-driven SVG adapter.

items.name: motion-director
items.title: Motion Director
items.description: Declarative choreography compiler over MG1: dependency-checked timing, joined property channels, shots, VT1 handoffs, typed cue metadata, seven parameterized recipes and aspect-specific scene presets. No clock or renderer engine.

items.name: motion-director-react
items.title: Motion Director React
items.description: Clock-free MotionDirector render boundary, shared MG1 samples, reduced-motion final composition and typed narration, speech, SFX and music cue hooks.

items.name: motion-react
items.title: Motion React
items.description: Render stage, motion box, kinetic text, vector draw, shape morph, mask reveal and scrubber components plus evaluation hooks that are pure functions of an explicit frame prop, owning reduced-motion handling and accessible labels.

items.name: explainer-stage
items.title: Explainer Stage
items.description: Measured essential text in safe regions around named protected subjects, with responsive portrait/landscape composition and explicit impossible-layout diagnostics.

items.name: semantic-composition
items.title: Semantic Composition
items.description: Compile MD1 event-linked actions, CC1 subject projection, critical visibility and measured explainer framing without duplicating camera or motion clocks.

items.name: crafted-3d
items.title: Crafted 3D Components
items.description: Optional physically based material kit with deterministic surface microstructure, studio lights and a detailed modular hardware enclosure with semantic ports.
